description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the MainActivity class for an Android application. The class manages user authentication (login and sign-up) and a simple calculator feature with basic arithmetic operations, including UI binding, event wiring, and user flow control.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing user login/sign-up and calculator functions within the Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, wires events, sets up a demo account, and shows the login screen.

methods.name: showLogin
methods.description: Displays the login interface by adjusting view visibility and header texts.

methods.name: showDashboard
methods.description: Displays the dashboard after login with a welcome message.

methods.name: attemptLogin
methods.description: Validates user input and authenticates against stored accounts, then navigates to dashboard.

methods.name: attemptSignUp
methods.description: Validates sign-up input, creates an account, and navigates to dashboard.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs arithmetic operations on input numbers and updates the UI with the result.
